entities.name: Julius Pokorný
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Julius Pokorny was an Austrian-Czech linguist and scholar of the Celtic languages and of Celtic studies, particularly of the Irish language, and a supporter of Irish nationalism. He held academic posts in Austrian and German universities.
